title: 2.1.1 AI Overview and Branches
description: Fundamental concepts, historical timeline, reasoning, generalization, machine learning, and robotics from Grade 11 ICT Section 2.1.

questions.question: What is the defining characteristic of an emerging technology?
options: A technology that evolves fast with prominent socio-economic impact
A legacy technology operating exclusively in administrative offices
A proprietary software application restricted to municipal systems
A hardware architecture designed solely for scientific calculations
questions.correctAnswer: A technology that evolves fast with prominent socio-economic impact

questions.question: What is the primary definition of Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
options: Designing computer systems that mimic human intelligence
Assembling circuit boards on vehicle manufacturing lines
Translating assembly language code into binary numbers
Managing relational database records across server nodes
questions.correctAnswer: Designing computer systems that mimic human intelligence

questions.question: Which two capabilities are artificial intelligence systems designed to emulate?
options: Reasoning and generalization
Compilation and interpretation
Defragmentation and indexing
Capacitance and conduction

questions.question: Which statement illustrates the cognitive process of logical reasoning?
options: My friend is not at work, so she must be at home
I repaired my own bicycle, so I can fix my friend's bicycle
I replaced the motherboard battery after listening to POST beeps
I updated the payroll database to calculate teacher tax rates
questions.correctAnswer: My friend is not at work, so she must be at home

questions.question: What does generalization in human and machine intelligence entail?
options: Applying past experiences to solve similar new problems
Eliminating duplicated records from related database tables
Formatting primary partition volumes into contiguous sectors
Writing explicit instruction sequences for every single task
questions.correctAnswer: Applying past experiences to solve similar new problems

questions.question: In which decade does the historical origin of artificial intelligence begin?
options: The 1940s
The 1920s
The 1960s
The 1980s

questions.question: In which decade was the formal term 'Artificial Intelligence' coined?
options: The 1950s
The 1930s
The 1970s
The 1990s

questions.question: What two factors explain the widespread popularity and power of AI today?
options: Growth in computer capacity and availability of massive data
Reduction in hardware prices and mandate of government laws
Decline of relational databases and adoption of dial-up lines
Elimination of malware threats and introduction of fast printers
questions.correctAnswer: Growth in computer capacity and availability of massive data

questions.question: What defines the branch of artificial intelligence known as Machine Learning?
options: Algorithms that learn from data and improve without explicit programming
Mechanical arms that assemble vehicle engines along factory conveyor lines
Manual entry of if-then rules to address every possible future situation
Transmission of structured binary packets across wide area optic cables
questions.correctAnswer: Algorithms that learn from data and improve without explicit programming

questions.question: What is the primary source from which machine learning algorithms learn?
options: Experience
Assemblers
Stabilizers
Transistors

questions.question: How do machine learning algorithms fundamentally operate compared to conventional programs?
options: They train on sample data to construct predictive decision models
They execute hard-coded instructions written line-by-line by programmers
They operate exclusively on analog vacuum tubes without digital memory
They process input requests using mechanical clockwork gears
questions.correctAnswer: They train on sample data to construct predictive decision models

questions.question: Which set of tasks represents common applications of Machine Learning?
options: Fraud detection, recommendation systems, and speech recognition
Disk defragmentation, registry scanning, and hardware cooling
Database indexing, primary key creation, and entity modeling
Cable crimping, monitor calibration, and toner replacement
questions.correctAnswer: Fraud detection, recommendation systems, and speech recognition

questions.question: What is the study of robotics defined as in the textbook?
options: The study of machines that substitute tasks traditionally done by humans
The scientific analysis of crystal structures under electron microscopes
The design of database architectures for managing personnel payroll
The development of high-voltage transmission cables for power stations
questions.correctAnswer: The study of machines that substitute tasks traditionally done by humans

questions.question: Where have industrial robots been primarily deployed over past decades?
options: Replacing human labor in car manufacturing assembly lines
Editing literary textbooks in government educational offices
Conducting oral language examinations in secondary classrooms
Managing retail accounting ledgers in municipal supermarkets
questions.correctAnswer: Replacing human labor in car manufacturing assembly lines

questions.question: Which hazardous environments are highlighted as ideal locations for robots?
options: Handling radioactive wastes, underwater areas, and space exploration
Secondary school lecture halls, library rooms, and study cubicles
Commercial banking lobbies, customer reception desks, and cafes
Urban grocery store checkout lanes, bakeries, and clothing shops
questions.correctAnswer: Handling radioactive wastes, underwater areas, and space exploration

questions.question: Which domestic machine exemplifies autonomous robotic labor in households?
options: A robot vacuum cleaner that cleans floors without human intervention
A manual hand broom operated by residential maintenance personnel
An electric steam iron that heats metallic plates when plugged in
A portable microwave oven that warms food items when timer is set
questions.correctAnswer: A robot vacuum cleaner that cleans floors without human intervention
